note: console-flat-visual-pass (milestone platform-console-flat-redesign), 2026-07-06. Visual-only pass over the REAL shipped IA (PlatformTenantDirectory.tsx + PlatformTenantDetail.tsx's 5 tabs) — no new screens, no new regions. No local headless-capture tooling in this worktree (same constraint as batches-workspace/batches-stats) — substituted with a published interactive Artifact, now at v5 (label contrast-and-grain-v5) after v2 ('tech/space/modern/flat...white luxury' redirect), v3 ('look boring' — dark rail/hero-scale/atmosphere fix), and v4 (icon/motion polish) — see DESIGN.md's four dated sub-bullets for full breakdowns. URL CHANGED at v5 (the v2-v4 link stopped resolving server-side, republished as a new file): https://claude.ai/code/artifact/93f09a35-c58f-4397-a8e6-460aadd2cab0 — also now saved to `mocks/console-flat-visual-pass.html` (cited since v1, not actually written until v5 — a real gap, closed). KNOWN GAP: this render tree still only models v2's token-level change (surface-muted->surface below); v3's dark nav-rail/ref-tag/hero-scale-type, v4's icons/sliding-tab-indicator/usage-bar/motion, and v5's contrast/grain/hairline-texture are NOT represented here — the current catalog.json vocabulary (Screen/Card/DataTable/Button/Badge/Heading/Text/Field props only) has no icon, animation, dark-surface-region, or texture-overlay concept to bind them to without inventing new catalog entries, which is out of scope for a read-only 'bind, don't break' prototype file. Left as an explicit, named gap rather than silently stale; close it (or raise a catalog change-request) once design-confirm is closer and the direction stops moving. v2's own change: every Screen/panel `bg` moved from `{semantic.color.surface-muted}` to `{semantic.color.surface}` (white) — canvas is near-white throughout, not slate-tinted; panel-level Card wrappers below are likewise `surface`, since v2's default separator is a hairline rule, not a distinct card background. Tab panels are modeled as sibling subtrees under detail_screen (config/budget/keys/members/plan) since the Tabs MECHANISM itself is pre-existing shipped chrome (components/ui/tabs.tsx) outside this task's own Touches — only panel CONTENTS change visually. `Tabs` has no catalog.json entry yet (gap, not invented here — catalog.json is read-only per design.md's 'bind, don't break' rule; a future change-request can add it). `DataTable`'s catalog schema only declares headerBg/text/border (no columns/rowCount) — actual column/row detail is described in each element's own `note` instead of invented props. A genuinely borderless Card OMITS the `border` prop entirely (the schema has no 'transparent' token value — omission is the accurate representation, not a literal string). Design-confirm OUTSTANDING — not yet approved by Tin at v2, v3, v4, or v5.
